items.label: Repost Cooldown: rescan recent posts
items.description: Re-reads the subreddit's recent posts so reposts of them are caught.

cooldownDays.label: Cooldown (days)
cooldownDays.helpText: A repost or same-sub crosspost is removed if the original is newer than this. Changes apply to posts made from now on.

checkCrossposts.label: Remove crossposts of posts from this subreddit

checkLinks.label: Remove posts that share a link with a recent post

maxTextLinks.label: Compare links inside a post's text when it has at most this many
maxTextLinks.helpText: A post with more links than this is treated as a roundup and its links are not compared. Set to 0 to ignore links inside text.

checkTitles.label: Remove posts that share a title with a recent post

minTitleLength.label: Shortest title to compare (letters and digits)
minTitleLength.helpText: Titles shorter than this, such as "Help" or "Question", are never treated as reposts. Set to 0 to compare every title.

checkText.label: Remove text posts that repeat the text of a recent post

minTextLength.label: Shortest text to compare (letters and digits)
minTextLength.helpText: Post text shorter than this is never treated as a repost. Set to 0 to compare every text.

exemptModerators.label: Never remove posts made by moderators

leaveComment.label: Leave a stickied comment explaining the removal

removalMessage.label: Removal comment
removalMessage.defaultValue:
Hi u/{author}, your post was removed because {reason}: [the earlier post]({original}), made {age}.

In r/{subreddit} the same post can be shared again once {cooldown} days have passed since the original.

*I am a bot. If you think this was a mistake, please [message the moderators](https://www.reddit.com/message/compose?to=r/{subreddit}).*
